empty.title: No click recorded on this page
empty.no_clicks: Visitors loaded this page but no click was captured over the selected period.
empty.scroll_title: No scroll measured on this page
empty.no_scrolls: Visitors loaded this page but no depth was measured over the selected period — a page that fits the screen never scrolls, so it measures nothing.
empty.sampled_out: Clicks and scrolls are sampled on {rate}% of page loads, and this page is too quiet for that rate to have caught any. Raise the sampling in the settings, or widen the period.
empty.tracking_off: Collection is disabled in the module settings, so no click or scroll is being recorded.

preview.snapshots_off: Page snapshots are off for this site
preview.snapshots_off_hint: Clicks and scrolls are still counted, but the heatmap is only drawn over a snapshot of the page as visitors see it: its text and images are then stored, every form field masked, for the snapshot retention set in the module settings. Enable it if that fits this site's privacy commitments.
preview.no_snapshot: No snapshot of this page yet
preview.no_snapshot_hint: The next sampled visit captures one — snapshots share the {rate}% click sampling — and it is refreshed daily. The heatmap is drawn as soon as it exists; the figures above are already exact.
preview.approximate_layout_hint: No visitor has been captured at this width yet, so the {layout} snapshot is reflowed here. Anchored clicks still land on their element.
preview.too_heavy_hint: The last sampled visit serialised {size} MiB of HTML and CSS, past the {limit} MiB upload cap, so this page has no backdrop. The click and scroll figures above are unaffected. A visit retries daily: lighter markup — or a heavy section marked data-dms-marketing-block — brings it under the cap.
preview.snapshots_enabled_hint: Capture the page as visitors see it, to draw the heatmap over it. Stores page content; changing this discards the site's snapshots.
preview.mask_text_hint: Replace every character of captured text with a placeholder. Form fields are always masked.
preview.options_error: Saving the snapshot options failed. Retry in a moment.
preview.overflow: Page wider than the chosen layout
preview.overflow_hint: The snapshot lays out at {width}px. The overlay follows the document, so it stays aligned; the backdrop may be cut off.
preview.oversized: Page too tall to preview accurately
preview.oversized_hint: The document exceeds the largest surface that can be drawn, so the overlay and the backdrop no longer line up. The click figures are unaffected.

no_website.title: No website tracked yet
no_website.description: Add a website, then embed the tracker snippet on the site to start collecting.

empty.title: No funnel on this site yet
empty.description: Create your first funnel: each step is a page URL or a custom event, matched in order within a session. Split it into A/B variations whenever you want to test a change against it.

no_sessions.title: No session entered this funnel
no_sessions.description: No session matched the first step over the selected period.

stop.title: Stop this split?
stop.description: Every visitor goes back to the control variation within a minute, pages already open at their next reload. Measurement stops and the results stay readable.

resume.title: Resume this split?
resume.description: The split resumes with the same variations and keeps the sessions already exposed; resuming to get another verdict can increase false positives.

funnels.locked_hint: Key and variations are frozen outside draft — weights moved mid-run would silently reassign visitors.

delete.title: Delete this funnel?
delete.description: “{name}” and its figure will disappear. The collected events and exposures stay until their retention passes.

form.name: Funnel name
form.steps_description: Each step is a page URL or a custom event, matched in order within a session — a single step counts conversions on its own.
form.experiment_description: Serve variations of the page to visitors, assigned server-side, and score each arm against the steps above.
form.key_description: The identifier page code passes to dmsMarketing.variation(…). Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
form.variations_description: 2 to 8 arms with relative weights; the first arm is the control.

results.reached_goal: {count} session reached the goal | {count} sessions reached the goal

insufficient_data.title: Not enough data yet
insufficient_data.description: Too few sessions to compare the arms — rates on a sample this thin would be noise, not signal. Raw counts below; verdicts appear once every arm has enough outcomes.

srm_warning.title: Sample ratio mismatch
srm_warning.description: The observed split across arms is far from the configured weights — assignment or exposure reporting may be broken; read these numbers with suspicion.

truncated.title: Window truncated
truncated.description: The raw-event window hit its cap: numbers cover the oldest part of the period only, and A/B verdicts are withheld.

empty.title: No exposure yet
empty.description: No session was exposed to this experiment while it was running. Its numbers are read over its own run, not over the selected period.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tracker_enabled_description: Master switch for the collect endpoint and the served tracker script.
settings.raw_retention_description: How long raw events are kept. Funnels and heatmaps read this window; dashboards use the daily rollups.
settings.stats_retention_description: How long daily rollups and sessions are kept. Capped at 760 days (25 months, the usual audience-measurement ceiling).
settings.heatmap_sample_description: Share of visits capturing click and scroll positions. Lower it on high-traffic sites.
settings.snapshot_retention_description: How long a captured page rendering is kept as a heatmap backdrop. Snapshots hold page content; never kept longer than the raw events.

form.name: Main site
form.domain_description: The site's apex domain, without scheme (example.com). Its subdomains are accepted as they are; other hosts — a staging host, another TLD — are added through the API's extraDomains.

snippet.title: Install the tracker
snippet.description: Add this tag to every page of {name}, right before the closing body tag or inside head. It is the same for every page of the site.
